package.name: go2_semantic_nav
package.description:
Semantic navigation for go2_nav: builds a 3D voxel map of CLIP embeddings from a recorded RGB-D + pose rosbag (SAM segmentation + CLIP encoding of each mask, projected via depth and the camera/lidar extrinsic), then resolves a plain-text query (e.g. "orange cone") to a Nav2 goal near the closest-matching voxel.
The offline map-building script (build_semantic_map.py) has no ROS runtime dependency -- only the online query node (semantic_goal.py) needs rclpy. Both need the ML deps (torch, CLIP, SAM) declared in the repo root's pyproject.toml and installed via `uv sync`, NOT rosdep -- run `uv sync` before using this package. See the repo README's "Semantic navigation" section.
